title: Mirabel and the Atlas
author: W. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Felix Thackeray, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
